reviewed_scope: Read-only source review of 92e8..ef17 directory-descriptor correction and complete seven-file SDK slice versus 30369de; independent host execution only.

resolved_findings.evidence: All three actual parent-swap tests pass. Additional real root-directory replacement is rejected, output remains in originally held directory, replacement path remains empty, and descriptors close.

blocking_findings.observed: read_bounded(root, 'out') opens an actual directory, then os.fdopen(..., 'rb') raises IsADirectoryError before the with suite obtains ownership. Independent /proc/self/fd inventory gained descriptor 5.
blocking_findings.impact: Rejected directory inputs leak one descriptor per call in a long-lived importing process; the command process eventually closes it at exit.
blocking_findings.requested_fix: Keep explicit ownership until fdopen has successfully constructed the stream. Close descriptor on type or fdopen construction failure, then transfer ownership to the stream; add an actual directory-leaf descriptor-inventory regression.
blocking_findings.reproduction_scope: Actual disposable filesystem directory and unmodified read_bounded; no mocked open/read/close for this failing control.

accepted_aspects: The fixed seven-file allowlist excludes private fixture client, state and administrative source.
All seven export pins match actual bytes; six unchanged payloads excluding SDK README match the recorded dd0 native/notices baseline.
Canonical eight-member USTAR output and complete byte comparison preserve deterministic packaging without archive extraction or execution.
Root and parent handles plus before/after directory identity checks reject the tested parent and root swaps.
O_EXCL retains existing output; an injected ENOSPC after 31 real bytes raises without success and preserves the residual file instead of unlinking a possibly replaced name.
SDK README, root README, developer flow and roadmap accurately leave independent consumer compilation, full API and #21 open.
